title: Blow To Uddhav Faction: Speaker Om Birla Approves Merger Of 6 UBT MPs With Shinde’s Shiv Sena
description: Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla has recognised the merger of 6 Shiv Sena UBT rebel MPs with the Shinde-led Shiv Sena, a setback for Uddhav Thackeray, raising the Shinde faction’s Lok Sabha strength to 13.
